description: This source file defines a generic class 'AzureTableDataManager<T>' that provides methods for managing Azure Table Storage entities, including creating, reading, updating, deleting, and batch operations, with integrated logging and error handling.

classes.name: AzureTableDataManager<T>
classes.description: A utility class for row-based access to Azure Table Storage, supporting CRUD operations, batch processing, and error handling for entities of type T implementing ITableEntity.

methods.name: InitTableAsync
methods.description: Initializes the Azure table, creating it if it does not exist, and handles connection setup.

methods.name: DeleteTableAsync
methods.description: Deletes the Azure table.

methods.name: ClearTableAsync
methods.description: Deletes all entities within the Azure table.

methods.name: CreateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new entity into the table; fails if the entity already exists.

methods.name: UpsertTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts or updates an entity in the table.

methods.name: InsertTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new entity; returns success status and ETag, or failure if conflict.

methods.name: MergeTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Merges an entity into the table, requiring an ETag.

methods.name: UpdateTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing entity with ETag matching.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Deletes an entity from the table using ETag.

methods.name: ReadSingleTableEntryAsync
methods.description: Reads a single entity by partition and row key, returning the entity and its ETag.

methods.name: ReadAllTableEntriesForPartitionAsync
methods.description: Reads all entities within a specific partition.

methods.name: ReadAllTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Reads all entities in the table.

methods.name: DeleteTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Deletes multiple entities in a batch operation.

methods.name: ReadTableEntriesAndEtagsAsync
methods.description: Reads entities matching a filter, returning entities with their ETags.

methods.name: BulkInsertTableEntries
methods.description: Inserts multiple entities in a batch operation.

methods.name: InsertTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Conditionally inserts two entities in a transaction, with ETag for the second.

methods.name: UpdateTwoTableEntriesConditionallyAsync
methods.description: Conditionally updates two entities in a transaction, with ETags.

methods.name: GetCloudTableCreationClientAsync
methods.description: Creates and returns a TableServiceClient for Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: CheckAlertWriteError
methods.description: Analyzes exceptions during write operations and logs warnings or errors accordingly.

methods.name: CheckAlertSlowAccess
methods.description: Logs a warning if an operation exceeds the configured timeout.
